messages:
jordyn-sales: Customer on Dedicated POC sees intermittent JSON parse errors when they call two tools in one generate call. Error reported: `JSONDecodeError: Extra data` and sometimes `Expecting value` during demo prep.

lee-eng: Do we have request ids and were they streaming?

jordyn-sales: Req ids: r_21a7 / r_21a8. Model: rwd-compat-7b-v3. They set json_mode=true and stream=true. Client logs show a 429 mid-stream then a truncated chunk.

marta-ml: Streaming + multiple fncalls = multiple top-level JSON objects in TCP stream. If a 429 interrupts, client may try to parse concatenation as one JSON doc -> "Extra data".

sam-se: Also seeing replacement char (�) and occasional leading BOM bytes at a tool output start. Likely an upstream vendor returning UTF-8 with BOM. We should strip BOM on ingest.

limit-bot: rate-limiter: customer-ded-5 - qps_alloc: 25, used: 25, reset_in: 16s

lee-eng: Short-term ask to the customer: set `stream=false` for the POC or invoke tools sequentially (call tool A, wait for closure, then tool B). We'll provide an SDK snippet showing per-request stream toggle.

marta-ml: We'll open a small runtime change to strip leading BOM bytes and add a framing token for tool boundaries in streaming. ETA for staging canary ~ 3-4h.

sam-se: For QSA: Dedicated keeps intermediate tool outputs in-memory per-request by default; no persistent object store unless customer enables explicit persistence. KMS customer-managed keys supported. I'll draft the blurb and send to you, jordyn.

jordyn-sales: I'll relay workaround: (1) stream=false for demo, (2) ops can temporarily bump QPS for demo window, (3) we'll push BOM-strip + framing fix to staging and follow up. Scheduling call with customer for 09:30 PT. Marking for SE handoff. :white_check_mark:
